title: What the arbitrator is
summary: A machine does not run provisioning scripts. It holds demands (start an MI with a service; serve a site). Its MachineArbitrator, the one authority over that machine's resources, turns the demands and the machine state into a ProvisionPlan: the ordered steps that reach the target state. Swap is the example: nobody decides it at install; a demand that needs it provisions it, and it goes when the demand ends or moves. dev1 is the planner only (src/Arbitrator.cls).
authority: built and tested offline (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-25)
invariants: One arbitrator per machine; it is the only authority over that machine's resources
A plan is data, not a script
